item.title: Brad Arnold, lead singer of Grammy-nominated rock band 3 Doors Down, dies at 47
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Brad Arnold, the lead singer of the Grammy-nominated rock band 3 Doors Down, died Saturday, months after he announced that he had been diagnosed with Stage 4 kidney cancer. item.title: Washington Post publisher Will Lewis says he’s stepping down, days after big layoffs at the paper

item.title: What to know about Nancy Guthrie’s kidnapping and the race to find her
item.description: It's been a week since Nancy Guthrie, the mother of “Today” show host Savannah Guthrie, disappeared from her home in Arizona in what authorities say was a kidnapping.

item.title: ‘We will pay,’ Savannah Guthrie says in desperate video plea to potential kidnappers of her mother
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. item.title: Savannah Guthrie says family ‘will pay’ for kidnapped mother’s return in social media video
item.description: A week after the kidnapping of her mother, Nancy Guthrie, "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie posted a video appearing to acknowledge the demands of ransom notes.

item.title: Payson community under ‘GO’ evacuation order for Bonita Fire
item.description: A community near Payson was placed under an evacuation order to leave their homes due to imminent danger from the nearby Bonita Fire.
